FROM THE OFFICE OF PRINCIPAL




It gives me immense pleasure to present this Prospectus for the academic session 2026–27 of Gyanpeeth
Degree College, Nikashi. Since its inception, our institution has remained committed to providing quality
higher education to students, especially those coming from rural, tribal, and international border areas.
Situated in a geographically sensitive international border region, the college carries a special
responsibility to empower the youth through education, awareness, and value-based learning. A
significant number of our students belong to diverse tribal communities, and we take pride in nurturing
an inclusive academic environment that respects cultural diversity while promoting academic excellence.
I am delighted to share that the college has recently introduced the Science stream, marking a new
milestone in our journey of growth and development. With the addition of 15 dedicated faculty members
in this stream, we are steadily expanding our academic horizon to meet the evolving needs of students
and society.
Our faculty members are highly qualified, experienced, and deeply committed scholars in their
respective fields. They continuously strive to inspire students through innovative teaching methods,
research orientation, and personal mentorship. Their dedication plays a vital role in shaping the
academic and moral character of our students.
At Gyanpeeth Degree College, we believe that education is not merely about acquiring degrees, but about
building responsible citizens equipped with knowledge, skills, and values. We encourage our students to
participate in co-curricular and extension activities, fostering leadership, social responsibility, and
holistic development.
I warmly invite aspiring students to be a part of this vibrant academic community and take advantage of
the opportunities provided here. Together, let us strive for excellence and contribute meaningfully to
society.
With best wishes for a bright and successful future.

                                                        Gyanpeeth Degree College (Session: 2026- 2027)

PROFILE OF THE COLLEGE
As a result of the relentless dedication and tireless efforts of local intellectuals, educationists, and
social workers of greater Nikashi, Gyanpeeth Degree College was established on August 1, 1993. The
college’s Governing Body—formed in 1991 under the leadership of eminent social thinker Mr.
Dayananda Bhandary as President and distinguished educationist Late Prasanna Sarma as
Secretary—pursued every possible avenue to bring the college to fruition and has ensured its
smooth operation since inception. It is gratifying to note that the sustained public support and
cooperation of the local community enabled the Governing Body to overcome early challenges in
financing, land acquisition, infrastructure development, and academic and administrative
management.
It is a matter of pride that the institute has been included under Sections 2(f) and 12(b) of the UGC
Act, 1956, and has been both recognized and provincialized by the Government of Assam. The
college currently enrolls 1,210 students. In the past two academic sessions, it has signed 17 MoUs
with various colleges, NGOs, and government agencies.

VISION
Upgrading the college to a full-fledged, multi-
disciplinary autonomous post-graduate institution.
The college envisions expanding its academic horizon
through the introduction of diverse post-graduate
programs, strengthening research and innovation,
and fostering a culture of academic excellence that
caters to regional and national needs.

research endeavours among faculty and students.
d. Foster unity, mutual respect, and harmony across
the student body.
e. Develop intellectually enlightened, honest, diligent,
and socially responsible citizens.
f. Equip students with the professional skills and
practical expertise needed for success.
g. Embrace continuous improvement and innovation
in teaching, learning, and institutional processes.

HOW TO APPLY FOR ASSAM COLLEGE ADMISSION ?
From the last academic session onward, the Government of Assam replaced the traditional UG
admission procedure with a fully online system via the Samarth Portal. All students who have
passed the Higher Secondary (10+2) examination must complete their applications online for
Bachelor’s degree courses. Once the application window closes, admissions are granted based on
the published merit lists and your listed college preferences. The Samarth Online Admission
Process is outlined below:
Step 1: Visit the website of DHE (https://directorateofhighereducation.assam.gov.in/).
Step 2: Then click on ONLINE ADMISSION tab.
Step 3: First Register yourself putting your basic details.
Step 4: Next, enter all personal and educational information as required.
Step 5: Upload your educational and other documents as required.
Step 6: At the end, submit the form. An acknowledgement receipt will be generated.
Step 7: Also, take a print of the submitted form and acknowledgement copy .
Note: You may list up to 10 choices of undergraduate programmes and institutions (colleges or
universities) in your application.

COLLEGE RULES AND REGULATIONS
The college authority has laid down the following rules which are essential for the healthy academic
life of an institution.
1. It is mandatory for all the students to come to college wearing prescribed uniform. No student
can attend class without uniform.
2. Students must come to college with their college identity. Any loss or damage of the card must be
brought to the knowledge of the college authority.
3. A student must have 75% of class attendance otherwise she/he will not be allowed to appear in
sessional examinations. If any student is found absent at least for 15 days at a stretch then he/she
will be considered discollegiate.
4. Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited. Strong disciplinary action will be taken against those
involved in such anti-academic activities.
5. Unlawful use of mobile phones inside college campus will result in disciplinary action.
6. Writing or sticking any bills on the college walls and rooms will result in disciplinary action. Any
notice to be pasted elsewhere in the college compound needs prior approval of the college
authority.
7. Any discourtesy shown to the teachers and office staff will be dealt with strict hands.
8. Students must refrain from indulging in any unfair means in the examination hall.
9. Students must clear their dues on time.
10. Smoking and consumption of liquor or any intoxicants leads to serious disciplinary action.
11. Students should park their bicycles or two-wheeler nowhere except for students' parking lot.
12. The Principal is the final authority for maintaining internal and external discipline of the
college and taking any final decision.
13. Selection test for offering Major course will be held after ten days from the commencement of
classes.
14. Guardians' presence in the guardian meeting is highly solicited for necessary feedback and
valuable suggestions.

Bodoland University. Inter-College Competitions are organized not only to boost a healthy

NATIONAL SERVICE SCHEME (NSS)
The NSS Cell of Gyanpeeth Degree College organized the 7-days NSS Special Camp from 17th to
23rd December, 2022. Sixty eight volunteers actively participated in the camp.During these seven
days different activities like literary survey on the population of the village, plantation
programme, training on Yoga, training on vermicompost, and participation in the Rising Day
celebration of 64 BN SSB at Dadagaon, quize competitions among school children, prabhat ferry
etc. were held. During 2023-24, District Level Yuva Mahatsav in collaboration with Nehru Yuva
Kendra, Mushalpur and International Yoga Day were organized in the college by NSS, Cell of
Gyanpeeth Degree College. Besides there on 17/9/2023 Amrit Brikshya (Tree) Abhiyan was
observed by the NSS unit of the college by planting 100 saplings and “ SHS Programme” in the
level of Jana Andolan was organised from 28th, Sep, 2023 to 1st Oct, 2023.

   Theory Classes:
    1 Credit = 15 Classes in one semester = 15 Contact hours in one semester.
   Tutorial Classes:

   Practical Classes:
   1 Credit (2h) = 30 Contact hours in one semester.

NOTE:
   Students willing to pursue UG Degree with Minors shall have to choose two disciplines (MIN-A
   and MIN-B) in the first semester and may opt to pursue MIN-A as a Major discipline in the 7th
   Semester if he/she secures 75 percent marks till 6th Semester with no backlog or betterment.
   Students willing to pursue 7 years UG Degree with a Major and Minor shall have to choose one
   Major (MAJ) and one Minor (MIN) in the first semester.

ASSIGNMENT

For instance, in a Minor Paper (Political Science), with a total of 240 students (12
groups of 20 students each), a common set of questions may be assigned to each
group, and students will submit their assignments individually.


GUIDELINES FOR INTERNSHIP
   Report to be prepared after completion of Internship. Report is to be signed by
   Supervisor.
   Daily dairy must be maintained by the student during internship period.
   Monitored by Industry and supervisor.
   Evaluation will be in 3 stages
   1st stage Evaluation by Industry/organization,
   2nd stage by Supervisor and
   3rd stage through seminar presentation/Viva/voce at HEIs.
   Authenticated internship report by the Head of the institution will be sent to
   CoE.
   On successful completion of internship only, students will be issued certificate
   from the University.
